title: Garden and Promise
author: Q. M. Almeida
blurb: Rosalind Almeida, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
